 Wed, 28 October 2026 
 Kathmandu, Oct 28: Sudurpaschim Royals and Pokhara Avengers are taking on each other in a match under the third season of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket tournament today.
 The match between these two teams will start at 5pm at the Tribhuvan International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur. Pokhara, captained by Kushal Bhurtel, has not yet been able to make it to the NPL final.
 Despite reaching the finals twice in a row under Dipendra Singh Airi's leadership, Sudurpaschim still has not been able to win the title.
 Eight teams are competing in this season's NPL as well. According to the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN), the NPL-3 will last till November 21.
 Meanwhile, Sri Lankan cricketer Sadeera Samarawickrama will be playing from Pokhara Avengers in this edition of NPL. (RSS)
